युष्मद् The base of the second
personal pronoun; (nom. त्वं, युवां,
यूयं) Thou, you; (at the beginning
of several compounds).

यूष् {c1c} P. (यूषति) To injure, kill,
hurt.

यूषः --षं यूषन् m. n. Soup, broth
pease-soup. (यूषन् has no forms for
the first five inflections, and is
optionally substituted for यूष after
acc. dual).
